descriptionHtml:
Our popular foam prints are sleek, modern, and super lightweight. Perfect to lift the look of any space - foam prints are versatile, available in various sizes, and will last for years to come.

Features:

  • Material: Solid PVC panel with a protective UV film for a lightweight, durable, and long-lasting print.
  • Texture & Finish: Smooth texture with an intense, natural look and feel, perfect for enhancing any space.
  • Color Options: Available in white and black.
  • Thickness: 5mm (0.2") for a modern, elegant finish.
  • Hanging Kit: Included with each foam board print; varies by country of fulfillment.
  • Available Sizes: 18 sizes (13 portrait/landscape, 5 square); inches for US/Canada, centimeters elsewhere. Sizes may vary slightly by region.
  • Packaging: Robust packaging ensures the foam board print arrives in pristine condition.
